title: cn_antibiotics: harmonized environmental antibiotics, CARSS resistance, and China yearbook covariates
description: R pipeline that turns literature-derived environmental antibiotic concentrations, CARSS clinical resistance data, and China Statistical Yearbook variables into harmonized, analysis-ready tables for province-level One Health reuse. This GitHub–Zenodo archive cites the software; curated data tables are deposited separately under CC BY 4.0 (see README Data Availability).
